messages:
Alex H: FYI customer ThermaTech (acct: thrm-402) reports a wire was RETURNED by the receiving bank. They called out a SWIFT/IBAN mismatch and a returned fee. Can payments look?
Raj P: Can you drop the tx id + raw request/response? quick check: was this routed through an intermediary bank?
Alex H: tx id tx_01G7YK2Z5A9
Alex H: request payload snippet:
```json
{
  "amount": 5200.00,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "beneficiary_name": "ThermaTech GmbH",
  "beneficiary_iban": "DE89370400440532013000",
  "beneficiary_bic": "BOFAUS3N",        // customer-provided (looks US BIC)
  "beneficiary_address": "",
  "routing_type": "wire",
  "intermediary_bank_bic": "CHASGB2L"
}
```
Alex H: bank response (sanitized): `RETURNED - INCOMPLETE_DETAILS - beneficiary address required / SWIFT mismatch`
payments-bot: Detected bank return code 0191 / reason: INCOMPLETE_PAYEE_DETAILS
Linda S: quick read: BIC `BOFAUS3N` is a US clearing BIC, IBAN is German. Receiving bank likely did an automated mismatch check and flagged it. Also beneficiary_address is empty — non-SEPA wires often need full address.
Raj P: repro steps for engineering ops: 1) fetch event logs `GET /v1/payments/tx_01G7YK2Z5A9/events` 2) inspect route chosen `route_id` 3) check our validation: `validate_iban_vs_bic(iban,bic)` returned false?
Raj P: cb run: I pulled logs, route used partner `europe-pay-03`, intermediary CHASGB2L forwarded. Bank returned after intermediary review.
Alex H: customer says they copied BIC from their ERP; they want us to re-send immediately and reimburse $35 wire fee. They attached PO #98765.
billing-bot: Customer billed wire fee: $35.00 on 2025-10-03. Refund requires manager approval or auto-refund policy match.
Linda S: For immediate workaround: we can either (A) reissue with corrected BIC (look up BIC from IBAN), and include full beneficiary address, or (B) switch to an ACH/EU SEPA route if customer bank supports it. But we need explicit confirmation from the payer on corrected details.
Raj P: Long-term fix: add server-side validation that flags IBAN/BIC country mismatch and require beneficiary_address for non-SEPA currency+route combos. Also add a rule to block user-supplied BICs that clearly conflict with IBAN country without explicit override.
Alex H: Customer asked for steps we already ran so they can do internal change too. Can we provide a minimal repro for them? e.g. commands to pull the returned wire payload and recommended corrected values.
Raj P: Provide this to customer: 
1) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/tx_01G7YK2Z5A9`
2) Corrected fields suggestion: `beneficiary_bic: DEUTDEFF` (example) and `beneficiary_address: "Musterstrasse 12, 10115 Berlin, Germany"`
3) If they prefer we resend, customer must confirm new BIC + full address and accept potential bank charges.
Alex H: I'll ask Maria to get confirmation. Maria, can you call ThermaTech and get updated BIC/address and confirm they want us to retry? Also ask if they'd like refund of the wire fee.
Maria G: On it, pinging now. ETA 20m. I'll collect updated payee info and share here. :phone: 
Linda S: Ops note: I'll create a short incident: `payments-validation-mismatch` and assign to infra + payments for a small validation patch. We'll aim for a rollback-safe rule: flag vs block.
Raj P: Also logging enhancement: include `iban_country` and `bic_country` in the routed event to make hunts easier.
Alex H: thanks. tagging for visibility: @Raj P @Linda S @Maria G. I'll mark this thread as escalation -> finance-sr.
billing-bot: Logged refund request rfd_7782, status: pending-approval.
Alex H: Customer reply (after call): "We confirm new BIC DEUTDEFF and address Musterstrasse 12, retry please. We approve reimbursement of the $35 fee."
Maria G: confirmed details & PO attached. Customer wants retry now.
Raj P: Ok - two action items: (1) Payments ops to reissue wire with corrected BIC/address via partner route (note: might incur another intermediary fee) (2) Finance to process $35 refund once manager signs off. I'll kick off the resend and post logs when done.
Linda S: assigning to myself to run the resend and monitor. Will paste event ids here. :white_check_mark:
Alex H: Great — keep this thread updated. Add a short postmortem once resolved so we can surface validation change to product.
Maria G: will collect customer sign-off email and upload to ticket.
Alex H: thx all.
